items.title: Tesla's supervised self-driving system often misreads speed limits, Belgian safety group finds
items.topic: Tesla's supervised self-driving system often misreads speed limits, Belgian safety group finds
items.summary: A Belgian safety group found that Tesla's supervised self-driving system frequently misreads speed limits, raising concerns about the reliability and safety of the technology. This issue could lead to increased risks of traffic violations and accidents, highlighting the need for further testing and improvements.

items.title: Tesla’s active robotaxi fleet in Austin crashes back to 8 vehicles after Cybercab pump
items.topic: Tesla’s active robotaxi fleet in Austin crashes back to 8 vehicles after Cybercab pump
items.summary: Tesla's active robotaxi fleet in Austin has decreased to 8 vehicles following a surge in the number of Cybercabs. This reduction may impact the availability and reliability of Tesla's robotaxi service in the city, affecting user experience and the company's operational goals.

items.title: Tesla Full Self-Driving bug falsely flags dirty cameras, demands service
items.topic: Tesla Full Self-Driving bug falsely flags dirty cameras, demands service
items.summary: Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) system has a bug that falsely flags cameras as dirty and demands service, causing inconvenience for users. This issue highlights the need for more robust and accurate sensor diagnostics in autonomous driving systems.

items.title: Real-Time Vision-Language Model Guided Semantic-Aware Diffusion Navigation with Intelligent Vehicle Validation
items.topic: Real-Time Vision-Language Model Guided Semantic-Aware Diffusion Navigation with Intelligent Vehicle Validation
items.source: 2025 IEEE 28th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC)
items.summary: The 2025 IEEE 28th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC) presents a vision-language model guided semantic-aware diffusion navigation method (VLSAN) for semi-structured campus road scenarios. Developed by researchers, VLSAN translates natural language instructions into vehicle motion control, leveraging a vision-language model (VLM) to generate semantically guided drivable region maps, achieving multimodal information fusion and semantic alignment.

items.title: Adaptive stress testing of autonomous vehicle-pedestrian interactions: A large language model (LLM) distillation approach
items.topic: Adaptive stress testing of autonomous vehicle-pedestrian interactions: A large language model (LLM) distillation approach
items.source: Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies
items.summary: Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies, Volume 194, Part A, published in January 2027, features a paper by Xiao Wen, Wentao Huang, Zhiyong Cui, and Sisi Jian. The paper introduces an adaptive stress testing approach for autonomous vehicle-pedestrian interactions using a large language model (LLM) distillation method, enhancing the robustness and safety of AV systems in complex urban environments.

items.title: Accurate and sample efficient driver takeover time prediction in autonomous driving with privacy preservation: A federated meta attentive interpretable tabular learning approach
items.topic: Accurate and sample efficient driver takeover time prediction in autonomous driving with privacy preservation: A federated meta attentive interpretable tabular learning approach
items.source: Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies
items.summary: Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies, Volume 193, published in December 2026, includes a study by Weida Yang, Zhizhou Wu, Yinhai Wang, and Yunyi Liang.
